hook.text: A clever tax system where lying about income costs you more than paying honestly. People report truthfully—voluntarily.

buildup.text: A mechanism is incentive-compatible when telling the truth is every player's best strategy. No tricks beat honesty.

discovery.text: The revelation principle: any outcome from any mechanism can be achieved by one where truth-telling is optimal.

twist.text: This simplifies design enormously: just consider truth-telling mechanisms and ignore all complex strategic play.

climax.text: Real-world systems like second-price auctions achieve incentive compatibility. Bidding your true value always wins.

punchline.text: The best mechanism makes honesty easy.

quiz.question: What does incentive compatibility mean?
options: Truth-telling is every player's best strategy
